thread:
sophia.chen: Quick question — our team used the company travel portal for the conf stay. Hotel sent a single master folio that includes a line "Conference shuttle service" for $480 (VAT incl). I paid my room on my personal card and requested reimbursement. How should I expense the shuttle since it sits on the hotel's folio and isn't itemized per person?

david_m: @sophia.chen did the portal show a breakdown when you booked? I remember it said 'transport bundled' but no per-person split.

travel-bot: Booking summary (CONF-2026): Hotel Aurora, 2026-02-14 — Master folio 900112. Shuttle service: $480. Rooms: 3 x $220/night. Payment: rooms charged to individual cards at check-in; folio shows shuttle charged to master and paid by card on file.

emma_finance: Hi @sophia.chen — short answer: we can reimburse, but need either (A) a vendor-level receipt/invoice from the shuttle operator showing who rode and amount, or (B) a manager confirmation and a reallocation note plus the hotel's folio PDF. VAT handling depends on the vendor invoice.

sophia.chen: I don't have the shuttle vendor receipt — hotel says it's their internal transfer. Manager (david) said everyone rode. What's required for VAT reclaim?

emma_finance: If we only have the hotel's folio, we treat it as a hotel incidental. For employees reimbursed personally, we can reimburse gross amount (no VAT reclaim for Redwood) unless the hotel issues a separate supplier invoice with VAT breakdown in the company's name. That means the VAT portion can't be reclaimed against corporate expenses unless the invoice shows the shuttle vendor and VAT registration.

david_m: ok — so for payroll expensing, should we split the $480 evenly three ways and submit three expense claims? Any extra approval?

emma_finance: Yes, split evenly is fine. Please do three separate expense submissions with: 1) PDF of master folio (folio 900112) attached, 2) brief note 'shared conference shuttle — split 3 ways', 3) manager confirmation (a single Slack approval from @david_m is OK). We'll process as non-VAT-reclaimable travel incidental.

sophia.chen: copying text for expense note: "Shared Conference Shuttle (Hotel Aurora folio 900112) — split 3 ways. No vendor invoice; reimbursement excludes VAT reclaim." Adding @david_m approval here for records.

david_m: Approved. All three reimbursed please. :thumbsup:

emma_finance: Thanks — one more thing: if someone paid the hotel's final bill (including shuttle) on a corporate card, we can do an internal reclass instead of three reimbursements. If that applies, ping finance with the corpcard txn id.

sophia.chen: nobody used corpcard for the final folio, so we'll each submit. Thanks!

travel-bot: Note added to booking CONF-2026: finance guidance applied — split shuttle, non-reclaimable VAT.
